hints: A best segment ending here either extends the previous best segment or starts at this value.
Keep that ending-here sum and a global maximum.
Initialize from the first element so an all-negative array still returns its largest value.
analogy: At each value, decide whether the old running segment is worth carrying forward.
example: For -2,3,-1,4,-5, the segment 3,-1,4 totals 6, the maximum.
algorithm: Apply Kadane's recurrence current=max(x,current+x), answer=max(answer,current), starting both at the first value.
correctness: Every segment ending here has one of those two forms, so the recurrence checks all candidates without missing a maximum.
complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
